purpose: Phase 1 web/runtime transfer derivatives for project-owned storehouse/workshop base colors

tool.name: Pillow
tool.operation: RGB resize with Image.Resampling.LANCZOS, then JPEG encode

source_policy: Original 1254x1254 RGB PNG files remain unchanged under assets/source/phase1/materials/. Runtime JPEGs are lossy derivatives only; they do not replace source art.
quality_measurement: PSNR is measured against a 512x512 LANCZOS resize of the original source, not against the original 1254x1254 raster.
limitations: These are base-color transfer derivatives only; no normal, roughness, AO or height maps are inferred from color.
JPEG is lossy and must receive visual QA under benchmark lighting before art acceptance.
512px is selected for the current RTS-distance benchmark and is not a close-up final-production texture claim.
